note: The reviewed half of the Desk repair queue. Grouping is derived; everything a person has to judge is recorded here. An issue is a candidate until its producer records that the deduplication was verified, and only a resolution receipt here can move an issue to resolved or, if the condition returns, to regressed. issue_key is the sha256 the queue derives from identity, so a hand edit to one and not the other fails the register check rather than binding to nothing. Every reference must be a stable https URL: an owner-only or local locator is refused, because a link nobody outside this repository can open is worse than no link.

engineering_card.label: Recorded disposition: browser-required community-board sources keep their typed state and never trigger a live page-load lookup
